values.name: Product version number
values.description: Number assigned by manufacturer or seller to identify the release of a product.

values.name: Assembly
values.description: The item number is that of an assembly.

values.name: HIBC (Health Industry Bar Code)
values.description: Article identifier used within health sector to indicate data used conforms to HIBC.

values.name: Cold roll number
values.description: Number assigned to a cold roll.

values.name: Hot roll number
values.description: Number assigned to a hot roll.

values.name: Slab number
values.description: Number assigned to a slab, which is produced in a particular production step.

values.name: Software revision number
values.description: A number assigned to indicate a revision of software.

values.name: UPC (Universal Product Code) Consumer package code (1-5-5)
values.description: An 11-digit code that uniquely identifies consumer packaging of a product; does not have a check digit.

values.name: UPC (Universal Product Code) Consumer package code (1-5-5- 1)
values.description: A 12-digit code that uniquely identifies the consumer packaging of a product, including a check digit.

values.name: Sample number
values.description: Number assigned to a sample.

values.name: Pack number
values.description: Number assigned to a pack containing a stack of items put together (e.g. cold roll sheets (steel product)).

values.name: UPC (Universal Product Code) Shipping container code (1-2- 5-5)
values.description: A 13-digit code that uniquely identifies the manufacturer's shipping unit, including the packaging indicator.

values.name: UPC (Universal Product Code)/EAN (European article number) Shipping container code (1-2-5-5-1)
values.description: A 14-digit code that uniquely identifies the manufacturer's shipping unit, including the packaging indicator and the check digit.

values.name: UPC (Universal Product Code) suffix
values.description: A suffix used in conjunction with a higher level UPC (Universal product code) to define packing variations for a product.

values.name: State label code
values.description: A code which specifies the codification of the state's labelling requirements.

values.name: Heat number
values.description: Number assigned to the heat (also known as the iron charge) for the production of steel products.

values.name: Coupon number
values.description: A number identifying a coupon.

values.name: Resource number
values.description: A number to identify a resource.

values.name: Work task number
values.description: A number to identify a work task.

values.name: Price look up number
values.description: Identification number on a product allowing a quick electronic retrieval of price information for that product.

values.name: NSN (North Atlantic Treaty Organization Stock Number)
values.description: Number assigned under the NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) codification system to provide the identification of an approved item of supply.

values.name: Refined product code
values.description: A code specifying the product refinement designation.

values.name: Exhibit
values.description: A code indicating that the product is identified by an exhibit number.

values.name: End item
values.description: A number specifying an end item.

values.name: Federal supply classification
values.description: A code to specify a product's Federal supply classification.

values.name: Engineering data list
values.description: A code specifying the product's engineering data list.

values.name: Milestone event number
values.description: A number to identify a milestone event.

values.name: Lot number
values.description: A number indicating the lot number of a product.

values.name: National drug code 4-4-2 format
values.description: A code identifying the product in national drug format 4-4-2.

values.name: National drug code 5-3-2 format
values.description: A code identifying the product in national drug format 5-3-2.

values.name: National drug code 5-4-1 format
values.description: A code identifying the product in national drug format 5-4-1.

values.name: National drug code 5-4-2 format
values.description: A code identifying the product in national drug format 5-4-2.

values.name: National drug code
values.description: A code specifying the national drug classification.

values.name: Part number
values.description: A number indicating the part.

values.name: Local Stock Number (LSN)
values.description: A local number assigned to an item of stock.

values.name: Next higher assembly number
values.description: A number specifying the next higher assembly or component into which the product is being incorporated.

values.name: Data category
values.description: A code specifying a category of data.

values.name: Control number
values.description: To specify the control number.

values.name: Special material identification code
values.description: A number to identify the special material code.

values.name: Locally assigned control number
values.description: A number assigned locally for control purposes.

values.name: Buyer's colour
values.description: Colour assigned by buyer.

values.name: Buyer's part number
values.description: Reference number assigned by the buyer to identify an article.

values.name: Variable measure product code
values.description: A code assigned to identify a variable measure item.

values.name: Financial phase
values.description: To specify as an item, the financial phase.

values.name: Contract breakdown
values.description: To specify as an item, the contract breakdown.

values.name: Technical phase
values.description: To specify as an item, the technical phase.

values.name: Dye lot number
values.description: Number identifying a dye lot.

values.name: Daily statement of activities
values.description: A statement listing activities of one day.

values.name: Periodical statement of activities within a bilaterally agreed time period
values.description: Periodical statement listing activities within a bilaterally agreed time period.

values.name: Calendar week statement of activities
values.description: A statement listing activities of a calendar week.

values.name: Calendar month statement of activities
values.description: A statement listing activities of a calendar month.

values.name: Original equipment number
values.description: Original equipment number allocated to spare parts by the manufacturer.

values.name: Industry commodity code
values.description: The codes given to certain commodities by an industry.

values.name: Commodity grouping
values.description: Code for a group of articles with common characteristics (e.g. used for statistical purposes).

values.name: Colour number
values.description: Code for the colour of an article.

values.name: Contract number
values.description: Reference number identifying a contract.

values.name: Customs article number
values.description: Code defined by Customs authorities to an article or a group of articles for Customs purposes.

values.name: Drawing revision number
values.description: Reference number indicating that a change or revision has been applied to a drawing.

values.name: Drawing
values.description: Reference number identifying a drawing of an article.

values.name: Engineering change level
values.description: Reference number indicating that a change or revision has been applied to an article's specification.

values.name: Material code
values.description: Code defining the material's type, surface, geometric form plus various classifying characteristics.

values.name: International Article Numbering Association (EAN)
values.description: Number assigned to a manufacturer's product according to the International Article Numbering Association.

values.name: Buyer's internal product group code
values.description: Product group code used within a buyer's internal systems.

values.name: National product group code
values.description: National product group code. Administered by a national agency.

values.name: General specification number
values.description: The item number is a general specification number.

values.name: Harmonised system
values.description: The item number is part of, or is generated in the context of the Harmonised Commodity Description and Coding System (Harmonised System), as developed and maintained by the World Customs Organization (WCO).

values.name: Buyer's item number
values.description: The item number has been allocated by the buyer.

values.name: Buyer's style number
values.description: Number given by the buyer to a specific style or form of an article, especially used for garments.

values.name: Buyer's size code
values.description: Code given by the buyer to designate the size of an article in textile and shoe industry.

values.name: Machine number
values.description: The item number is a machine number.

values.name: Manufacturer's (producer's) article number
values.description: The number given to an article by its manufacturer.

values.name: Model number
values.description: Reference number assigned by the manufacturer to differentiate variations in similar products in a class or group.

values.name: Product/service identification number
values.description: Reference number identifying a product or service.

values.name: Batch number
values.description: The item number is a batch number.

values.name: Customer order number
values.description: Reference number of a customer's order.

values.name: Part number description
values.description: Reference number identifying a description associated with a number ultimately used to identify an article.

values.name: Purchaser's order line number
values.description: Reference number identifying a line entry in a customer's order for goods or services.

values.name: Purchase order number
values.description: Reference number identifying a customer's order.

values.name: Promotional variant number
values.description: The item number is a promotional variant number.

values.name: Buyer's qualifier for size
values.description: The item number qualifies the size of the buyer.

values.name: Returnable container number
values.description: Reference number identifying a returnable container.

values.name: Release number
values.description: Reference number identifying a release from a buyer's purchase order.

values.name: Run number
values.description: The item number identifies the production or manufacturing run or sequence in which the item was manufactured, processed or assembled.

values.name: Record keeping of model year
values.description: The item number relates to the year in which the particular model was kept.

values.name: Supplier's article number
values.description: Number assigned to an article by the supplier of that article.

values.name: Standard group of products (mixed assortment)
values.description: The item number relates to a standard group of other items (mixed) which are grouped together as a single item for identification purposes.

values.name: SKU (Stock keeping unit)
values.description: Reference number of a stock keeping unit.

values.name: Serial number
values.description: Identification number of an item which distinguishes this specific item out of a number of identical items.

values.name: RSK number
values.description: Plumbing and heating.

values.name: IFLS (Institut Francais du Libre Service) 5 digit product classification code
values.description: 5 digit code for product classification managed by the Institut Francais du Libre Service.

values.name: IFLS (Institut Francais du Libre Service) 9 digit product classification code
values.description: 9 digit code for product classification managed by the Institut Francais du Libre Service.

values.name: EAN.UCC Global Trade Item Number
values.description: A unique number, up to 14-digits, assigned according to the numbering structure of the EAN.UCC system. 'EAN' stands for the 'International Article Numbering Association', and 'UCC' for the 'Uniform Code Council'.

values.name: Supplier's supplier article number
values.description: Article number referring to a sales catalogue of supplier's supplier.

values.name: Style number
values.description: Number given to a specific style or form of an article, especially used for garments.

values.name: Transport group number
values.description: Additional number to form article groups for packing and/or transportation purposes.

values.name: Ultimate customer's article number
values.description: Number assigned by ultimate customer to identify relevant article.

values.name: UPC (Universal product code)
values.description: Number assigned to a manufacturer's product by the Product Code Council.

values.name: Vendor item number
values.description: Reference number assigned by a vendor/seller identifying a product/service/article.

values.name: Vendor's (seller's) part number
values.description: Reference number assigned by a vendor/seller identifying an article.

values.name: Vendor's supplemental item number
values.description: The item number is a specified by the vendor as a supplemental number for the vendor's purposes.

values.name: Vendor specification number
values.description: The item number has been allocated by the vendor as a specification number.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: A code assigned within a code list to be used on an interim basis and as defined among trading partners until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.
